mapper.select: SELECT pc.id, pc.module_id, pc.data_name, pc.phone, pc.create_time, pc.scope_user_id, ofr.create_time AS last_time FROM crm_pre_customer pc LEFT JOIN ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY data_id ORDER BY create_time DESC) as rn FROM crm_on_follow_rel ) ofr ON pc.id = ofr.data_id AND ofr.rn = 1 WHERE pc.data_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{checkDTO.checkValue}, '%') ORDER BY pc.update_time DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT pc.id, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_on_follow_rel ofr INNER JOIN crm_on_follow f ON ofr.data_id = f.id WHERE ofr.rel_module_id = pc.module_id AND ofr.rel_data_id = pc.id AND f.del_flag = 1) AS follow_num, DATEDIFF(NOW(),IFNULL(( SELECT MAX( create_time ) FROM crm_on_follow_rel ofr2 WHERE ofr2.rel_module_id = pc.module_id AND ofr2.rel_data_id = pc.id ),pc.create_time)) AS unfollow_days, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_on_business ob WHERE ob.customer_id = pc.id AND ob.del_flag = 1 ) AS business_num, ( SELECT SUM( real_money ) FROM crm_on_business ob2 WHERE ob2.customer_id = pc.id AND ob2.del_flag = 1 ) AS business_money, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_on_contract oc WHERE oc.customer_id = pc.id AND oc.del_flag = 1 ) AS contract_num, ( SELECT SUM( real_money ) FROM crm_on_contract oc2 WHERE oc2.customer_id = pc.id AND oc2.del_flag = 1 ) AS contract_money, ( SELECT SUM( received_money ) FROM crm_on_contract oc3 WHERE oc3.customer_id = pc.id AND oc3.del_flag = 1 ) AS received_money, ( SELECT SUM( unreceived_money ) FROM crm_on_contract oc4 WHERE oc4.customer_id = pc.id AND oc4.del_flag = 1 ) AS un_received_money, ( SELECT SUM( real_money ) FROM crm_on_invoice oi WHERE oi.customer_id = pc.id AND oi.del_flag = 1 ) AS invoice_money FROM crm_pre_customer pc WHERE pc.id = #{customerId}
